task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the 'Sund Rock' trip header (dated 2010-12) highlighted or expanded in the dive list.

task_completion.description: Select all four dives within the 'Sund Rock' trip for batch editing.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Four dive entries under the 'Sund Rock' trip should be visually highlighted/selected simultaneously in the dive list.

task_completion.description: Set the Water Temperature to 9°C in the dive equipment or notes/details panel.

task_completion.description: Save the changes to the dive log.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks 'File' > 'Save' or a save icon, or a 'Save' button in the edit panel becomes inactive/disappears after clicking.

integrity.description: The agent did not modify the 'Yellow House' trip temperatures.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Sund Rock' trip is dated December 2010 (2010-12) and contains exactly 4 dives. The 'Yellow House' trip is dated September 2011 (2011-09) and must not be edited. The target values are exactly 15°C for Air and 9°C for Water. There are 29 total dives in the logbook.
